name: Satan
overview: Scripture introduces Satan as the cunning serpent who deceived Eve in the Garden of Eden by questioning God's command and denying the certainty of death as a consequence of disobedience. Because of this deception, God cursed the serpent above all creatures and declared ongoing enmity between the serpent and the woman's offspring, foreshadowing the ultimate defeat of Satan. The term 'Belial,' associated with wickedness and worthlessness, further illustrates the nature of Satan and his followers as corrupt and opposed to God's order.
